<div id="app">
<header><button class="b" id="bk" style="visibility:hidden">☰ Màn</button><h1>⚫ Takuzu</h1><span id="lv"></span></header>
<section id="menu"><p id="sub"></p><div id="grid"></div><p class="hp">Điền 0 và 1: không quá 2 số giống nhau liền kề, mỗi hàng/cột có số 0 và 1 bằng nhau, và không có 2 hàng (hoặc 2 cột) giống hệt nhau.</p></section>
<section id="play" hidden><div id="info"></div><div id="board"></div><div id="msg"></div><div id="ctl"></div></section>
<div id="md" hidden><div class="box"><h2 id="mt"></h2><p id="mx"></p><div id="mb"></div></div></div>

<script>
const GAME={key:'takuzu'};
const MAX=100,KEY='gp_'+GAME.key;
let prog=0,L=1,over=false;
try{prog=Math.min(MAX,+localStorage.getItem(KEY)||0)}catch(e){}
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,prog)}catch(e){}};
const rng=s=>()=>{s|=0;s=s+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(s^s>>>15,1|s);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296};
const side=x=>Math.max(200,Math.min(innerWidth-20,innerHeight-215-(x||0),720));
const setInfo=h=>{$('#info').innerHTML=h},say=t=>{$('#msg').textContent=t||''};
const stop=()=>{if(typeof onStop=='function')onStop()};
function fitMenu(){const s=Math.max(240,Math.min(innerWidth-20,innerHeight-175,640)),g=$('#grid');g.style.width=g.style.height=s+'px';g.style.fontSize=Math.max(11,s/10*.36)+'px'}
function menu(){
 stop();$('#play').hidden=true;$('#menu').hidden=false;$('#md').hidden=true;
 $('#bk').style.visibility='hidden';$('#lv').textContent='';
 $('#sub').textContent='Đã qua '+prog+'/'+MAX+' màn';
 let h='';for(let i=1;i<=MAX;i++)h+='<button class="'+(i<=prog?'done':i==prog+1?'cur':'lock')+'" data-l="'+i+'"'+(i>prog+1?' disabled':'')+'>'+i+'</button>';
 $('#grid').innerHTML=h;fitMenu();
}
function play(l){
 stop();L=l;over=false;$('#md').hidden=true;$('#menu').hidden=true;$('#play').hidden=false;
 $('#bk').style.visibility='visible';$('#lv').textContent='Màn '+l;
 const b=$('#board');b.className='';b.removeAttribute('style');b.innerHTML='';b.onclick=b.onpointerdown=b.onpointermove=b.onpointerup=b.onpointercancel=null;
 $('#ctl').innerHTML='';say('');setInfo('');start(l);
}
function modal(t,x,btns){$('#mt').textContent=t;$('#mx').textContent=x;const m=$('#mb');m.innerHTML='';
 btns.forEach(a=>{const e=document.createElement('button');e.className='b '+(a[2]||'');e.textContent=a[0];e.onclick=a[1];m.appendChild(e)});$('#md').hidden=false}
function win(x){if(over)return;over=true;if(L>prog){prog=L;save()}stop();
 setTimeout(()=>{if(!$('#menu').hidden)return;const fin=L>=MAX,bt=[];if(!fin)bt.push(['Màn tiếp ▶',()=>play(L+1),'on']);bt.push(['Chơi lại',()=>play(L)],['Chọn màn',menu]);
  modal(fin?'🏆 Hoàn thành cả 100 màn!':'🎉 Qua màn '+L+'!',x||'',bt)},450)}
function fail(x){if(over)return;over=true;stop();modal('Chưa được',x||'',[['Thử lại',()=>play(L),'on'],['Chọn màn',menu]])}
$('#grid').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(b&&!b.disabled)play(+b.dataset.l)};
$('#bk').onclick=menu;
addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(!$('#menu').hidden)fitMenu();else if(typeof relayout=='function')relayout()});

let n,sol,g,gv;
function ln(t,n){const ix=[];for(let k=0;k<n;k++)ix.push(t<n?t*n+k:k*n+t-n);return ix}
function prop(a,n){
 let ch=true;
 while(ch){ch=false;
  for(let t=0;t<2*n;t++){
   const ix=ln(t,n);
   for(let k=0;k<n-2;k++){const x=a[ix[k]],y=a[ix[k+1]],z=a[ix[k+2]];
    if(x>=0&&x==y){if(z==x)return false;if(z<0){a[ix[k+2]]=1-x;ch=true}}
    if(y>=0&&y==z&&x<0){a[ix[k]]=1-y;ch=true}
    if(x>=0&&x==z&&y<0){a[ix[k+1]]=1-x;ch=true}}
   let c0=0,c1=0;for(const i of ix){if(a[i]==0)c0++;else if(a[i]==1)c1++}
   if(c0>n/2||c1>n/2)return false;
   if(c0==n/2&&c1<n/2)for(const i of ix)if(a[i]<0){a[i]=1;ch=true}
   if(c1==n/2&&c0<n/2)for(const i of ix)if(a[i]<0){a[i]=0;ch=true}
  }}
 return true}
function valid(a,n){for(const off of[0,n]){const s=new Set();for(let r=0;r<n;r++)s.add(ln(off+r,n).map(i=>a[i]).join(''));if(s.size<n)return false}return true}
function solve(a0,n,lim){let cnt=0;(function go(a){if(cnt>=lim)return;if(!prop(a,n))return;const i=a.indexOf(-1);if(i<0){if(valid(a,n))cnt++;return}for(const v of[0,1]){const b=a.slice();b[i]=v;go(b)}})(a0.slice());return cnt}
function genSol(n,R){for(let t=0;t<80;t++){let nodes=0,res=null;(function go(a){if(res||nodes++>3000)return;if(!prop(a,n))return;const i=a.indexOf(-1);if(i<0){if(valid(a,n))res=a;return}const f=R()<.5?0:1;for(const v of[f,1-f]){const b=a.slice();b[i]=v;go(b)}})(Array(n*n).fill(-1));if(res)return res}return null}
function start(l){
 n=l<=10?4:l<=30?6:l<=55?8:l<=80?10:12;
 const lo=n==4?1:n==6?11:n==8?31:n==10?56:81,hi=n==4?10:n==6?30:n==8?55:n==10?80:100,p=(l-lo)/(hi-lo);
 const R=rng(l*6007+3);sol=genSol(n,R);
 const p0=sol.slice(),tg=Math.round(n*n*(.58-.26*p)),t0=Date.now();let clues=n*n;
 for(const i of [...Array(n*n).keys()].sort(()=>R()-.5)){if(clues<=tg||Date.now()-t0>700)break;const v=p0[i];p0[i]=-1;if(solve(p0,n,2)!=1)p0[i]=v;else clues--}
 g=p0.slice();gv=p0.map(v=>v>=0);
 const b=$('#board');b.className='tk';b.innerHTML='<div></div>'.repeat(n*n);
 b.onclick=e=>{const el=e.target.closest('#board>div');if(!el||over)return;const i=[...b.children].indexOf(el);if(gv[i])return;g[i]=g[i]<0?0:g[i]==0?1:-1;draw()};
 $('#ctl').innerHTML='<button class="b" id="h">💡 Gợi ý</button><button class="b" id="c">🗑 Xoá làm lại</button>';
 $('#ctl').onclick=e=>{const t=e.target.closest('button');if(!t||over)return;if(t.id=='c'){g=p0.slice();draw()}else{const k=[...Array(n*n).keys()].filter(i=>g[i]!=sol[i]);if(k.length){const i=k[R()*k.length|0];g[i]=sol[i];draw()}}};
 relayout();draw();say('Chạm ô để đổi: trống → 0 (xanh) → 1 (cam) → trống. Ô viền đỏ đang vi phạm luật.');
}
function relayout(){const b=$('#board');if(!b.classList.contains('tk'))return;const z=Math.floor(Math.min((innerWidth-24)/n,(innerHeight-225)/n,64));b.style.gridTemplateColumns='repeat('+n+','+z+'px)';b.style.gridAutoRows=z+'px';b.style.fontSize=z*.5+'px';b.style.width=n*z+(n-1)*3+'px'}
function bad(){
 const b=new Set();
 for(let t=0;t<2*n;t++){const ix=ln(t,n);
  for(let k=0;k<n-2;k++){const x=g[ix[k]];if(x>=0&&x==g[ix[k+1]]&&x==g[ix[k+2]]){b.add(ix[k]);b.add(ix[k+1]);b.add(ix[k+2])}}
  for(const v of[0,1])if(ix.filter(i=>g[i]==v).length>n/2)ix.forEach(i=>{if(g[i]==v)b.add(i)})}
 for(const off of[0,n]){const m=new Map();for(let r=0;r<n;r++){const ix=ln(off+r,n);if(ix.some(i=>g[i]<0))continue;const k=ix.map(i=>g[i]).join('');if(m.has(k)){ix.forEach(i=>b.add(i));m.get(k).forEach(i=>b.add(i))}else m.set(k,ix)}}
 return b}
function draw(){
 const cs=$('#board').children,bd=bad();
 for(let i=0;i<n*n;i++){cs[i].className=(g[i]==0?'z0':g[i]==1?'z1':'')+(gv[i]?' gv':'')+(bd.has(i)?' bd':'');cs[i].textContent=g[i]<0?'':g[i]}
 setInfo('Ô trống: <b>'+g.filter(v=>v<0).length+'</b>');
 if(!g.includes(-1)&&!bd.size)win('Bảng 0/1 đã hoàn chỉnh!');
 else if(!g.includes(-1))say('Đã điền hết nhưng còn ô vi phạm (viền đỏ).');
}

menu();
</script></body></html>
